derivedTask.title: Transfer - Geometry Audit CSV
derivedTask.goal: Bake each Three.js part into world-space Z-up geometry and write a deterministic CSV audit with part bounds and polygon counts.
derivedTask.skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on nearest-named-ancestor partitioning, InstancedMesh expansion, world-transform baking, child-link exclusion, and Z-up coordinate conversion.
